title: Which grilling material becomes a destination question card, and can a card exist without a landmark?
question: Which grilling material becomes a destination question card, and can a card exist without a landmark?
answer:
LD-31: Yes, owner identifies conceptual groups as destination questions. Retitle meaningfully and preserve source question IDs; exact example groupings/titles not final. Settled-question summary approved, without implementation or promotion authorization.
LD-17: Show meaningful concept syntheses, relationships and step distributions, rather than a card for every conversational prompt. Keep readable explanations in the Wiki. Proposed presentation: concise title and distribution, with source lineage and assessments available on expansion.
LD-30: Questions can be tracked without landmark; show no landmark. Early Idea/Aligning grouping can remain unsettled or change. Concept growth: grilling question -> destination question -> landmark if consequential enough. Main-project association tentative; record conversion and threshold unspecified.
